examples.text: Currently enjoying @mitchelmusso's incredible new album! Hurry and give it a listen! Meanwhile, I'm preparing for a tedious chemistry test.
@lyndseyparker oh no that's terrible! I actually have such admiration for him, so I genuinely empathize with his situation.
Carrying one for allergies isn't a bad idea! Even grown men can be affected with a closed throat and little air!
Alright, you have won. I have removed chocolate from my diet, but replacing it with jam isn't always a successful alternative!
I work, but soon I'm heading to the barn to prepare my horse for tomorrow's show in Colombus, NE! Exciting!
Hooray! Successfully completed my internet marketing test! Now awaiting my task outcomes.
Phew, I feared my bag was forgotten at McD's, but it was just at a friend's.
I recall watching Clueless and singing "Rollin with the Homies" LOL.
Working hard and taking a break now! Yay! Haha! I desperately need a nap soon!
Decoder ring party cancelled, but I'm chilling with Noah tonight, so not a total loss.
